newsitem.title: POLAND: Rafako likely to find investor by July.
newsitem.headline: Rafako likely to find investor by July.

text.p: Polish industrial boilermaker Rafako is about to start final talks with at least two firms, which would lead to choosing one investor to take a strategic stake in Rafako by the end of June, Rafako's deputy head said.
Maciej Kaczorowski told Reuters on Wednesday the company's shareholders would vote on June 30 on a share issue of between 3,170,000 and 8,070,000 shares, to be taken up by the investor.
"By the end of the month we will choose at least two investors with whom we will be carrying negotiations... we intend to finalise it (the agreement with an investor) by the end of June," he said.

Rafako last year had an issue of between 3.17 and 4.17 million shares approved but it was put off because the company was not satisfied with a price set through book-building and now wanted the shareholders to increase the planned issue.
Rafako had so far talked with five investors, one domestic and four foreign, Kaczorowski said.
Rafako has said it was seeking an investor to strengthen its position on the market.
